articles.summary: CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - EverQuote, Inc. (Nasdaq: EVER), a leading provider of growth solutions for property and casualty insurance providers, today published a white paper titled “ Agentic Barbarians at the Carriers’ Gates - Personal AI Agents and the Future of PC Insurance Distribution ” examining the impact of Personal AI Agents on the PC insurance sector today and the opportunities for carriers to adapt and thrive in the era of agentic shopping. The report helps carriers and other market participants understand and navigate new models for customer acquisition and engagement as AI reshapes insurance distribution. articles.title: EverQuote Releases New White Paper Addressing Personal AI Agents and the Future of P&C Insurance Distribution
